purpose: Adventure Lab — The Last Bell; original coastal fantasy assets

args.description: Native 256x144 crisp pixel-art title illustration for an original 16-bit JRPG called The Last Bell (do NOT draw letters or text). Windswept midnight coastline, a tall ivory lighthouse at the right, enormous green-blue moon and distant drowned observatory under the ocean horizon at left. Three tiny travelers on a stone causeway, one warm amber lantern. Sea-glass teal, ink navy, muted violet shadows, pale ivory and a few luminous gold highlights. Confident hard pixel clusters, sharp architectural silhouettes, no anti-aliasing, no photographic detail, restrained clean sky space across upper third for a separately rendered game title. Original art, not a franchise copy.
